security_notice_hr: Nakon aktivacije Zoho Mail sustava, korisničko ime i lozinka unosit će se isključivo na službenoj sigurnoj Zoho prijavnoj stranici. GNK ASG portal neće tražiti niti pohranjivati zaporku e-pošte.
security_notice_en: After activation of the Zoho Mail system, the username and password will be entered only on the official secure Zoho sign-in page. The GNK ASG portal will not request or store any email password.
purpose: official corporate contact, web form routing, WhatsApp contact and basic portal guidance

routing.label: General company information
routing.answer: For general information about GNK ASG d.o.o., please use the public portal sections, GNK ASG Insights, or send a written inquiry to contact@gnk-asg.hr.

routing.label: Public documents and sources
routing.answer: For public documents and source references, please open the Documents and Sources sections on gnk-asg.hr. Formal requests should be sent to contact@gnk-asg.hr.

routing.label: Business cooperation
routing.answer: For cooperation proposals, please send a short written summary, company details and contact information to contact@gnk-asg.hr.

routing.label: Media inquiry
routing.answer: For media inquiries, please send the question, publication name, deadline and contact details to contact@gnk-asg.hr.

routing.label: Meeting request
routing.answer: For meeting requests, please send the proposed topic, participants and preferred time window to contact@gnk-asg.hr.

routing.label: Portal technical issue
routing.answer: For portal technical issues, please send a screenshot, device/browser information and a short description to contact@gnk-asg.hr.
